description: Board with global or per-stage WIP, per-column colors and transition rules. Drag by the handle or use keyboard/menu. Column and toolbar actions are composition, with no built-in business rules.

howToUse: Use it for work that moves through stages: sales pipeline, tasks, hiring.
Pass the `columns` with their cards and save the moves in `onColumnsChange`. Open a card in `onCardClick`.
Set a limit per column with `wipLimit` and the allowed moves with `allowedTransitions`. Check them on your server too: two people can move the same card.
Each card can also be moved by its menu, without dragging.
alternatives: Comparing many fields of each item: Table.
Dates and deadlines: Calendar or Timeline.

keyboard.action: Picks up the card, and drops it again.
With the card picked up, chooses the column.
Cancels the move and puts the card back.

props.name: wipLimit
props.description: Default limit per column; undefined means unlimited.

props.name: allowedTransitions
props.description: Source → allowed targets. A missing key allows all; [] blocks leaving.

props.name: filter
props.description: Filters the display; WIP and moves keep using all cards.

props.name: instructions
props.description: "hidden" removes the drag instruction from the screen and keeps it for screen readers.
